ddl.name: jobs_check
ddl.value: ((kind = 0 AND builder IS NULL) OR (kind = 1 AND builder IS NOT NULL)) AND status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)

ddl.name: idx_jobs_build
ddl.where: kind = 1 AND builder IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: catalog
ddl.definition: SELECT p.product_id AS product_pk, p.workspace_pk, p.platform, a.guid, p.sub_id, p.path, p.kind, p.format, p.version, p.aliases, p.registration, p.digest, p.bytes, e.path AS source, e.schema, p.job_pk, j.builder, j.key AS job_key FROM products AS p INNER JOIN assets AS a ON p.asset_pk = a.asset_id INNER JOIN jobs AS j ON p.job_pk = j.job_id INNER JOIN entries AS e ON e.workspace_pk = p.workspace_pk AND e.asset_pk = p.asset_pk WHERE e.diff IN (0, 1, 2) AND j.status IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY p.path, a.guid, p.sub_id
